TIBT 233.d: Introducing the Tibetan alphabet and basics of grammar through reading section of a classic Tibetan text. In addition, readings in English in Indian and Tibetan Buddhist materials, also on the art, history, geography and /or modern era in those areas. Final includes a paper drawn from readings and class discussion. Cross-list: RELI 233.
TIBT 233.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.
